ideas.title: Minnesota Child Care Fraud Scandal: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate allegations of large-scale child care fraud in Minnesota, including potential misuse of funds and entities involved.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover the extent of the fraud and who is responsible.
questions: What is the scale of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and misuse of funds meant for child care. It requires a deep dive into financial records and entities involved.

ideas.title: Investigation into Rondale Moore's Death
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the death of Minnesota Vikings WR Rondale Moore at age 25.
ideas.angle: Determine the cause of death and any potential wrongdoing.
questions: What was the cause of death?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe it's crucial to thoroughly examine the circumstances surrounding Moore's death, especially given his high profile.
